# ame_dev

ame_dev is an independent Windows app developer based in Japan.
Official site: https://hello-amedev.github.io/
Contact: amemitai@gmail.com

## Drive DAM

Drive DAM is a digital asset management (DAM) app for Windows that works directly
on folders you already have — shared folders on Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, or a
company file server, as well as local folders. It adds tags, color labels, usage
permissions, favorites, and fast filtered search on top of the existing folder
structure, without moving, importing, or modifying files. Tags and thumbnails are
shared with the whole team through the shared folder itself; no server and no
account are required, and nothing is sent to any external service.

Key facts:

- Platform: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11
- Formats: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, camera RAW (NEF, CR2, ARW, DNG, and more),
  PDF (in-app viewing), plus tagging and search for videos and Office files
- Pricing: one-time purchase with a 30-day full-featured free trial (Microsoft Store)
- Interface languages: English, Japanese
